name: Crocodile Crisis
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Place umbrella in the crocodile’s mouth. Wedge the warning sign between its teeth.
Feed the skeleton to distract the crocodile.
Use the wooden door to hold its jaws open.
Put the stone cross into its mouth.
Feed the purple mushroom to make it dizzy.
Splash cold water on the crocodile.
Drop the cannonball into its mouth.
Tickle its throat with the cattail reed.
Tap the vine and let Tarzan rescue the woman.
